notes.title: WARNING!! UNKNOWN SPACE LIFE found!!
notes.content:
［Update 2019.03.23]

1. New UNKNOWN SPACE LIFE!
Attention Caption, UNKNOW SPACE LIFE was in found 1-4、1-5
With territorial, will attack player's ship while closing 
Of course, you could use the weapon to fight with them

2. Now your ship has HP!
While HP=0, your ship will explode, 
To recover HP, recombine your ship.

3.NEW! Manual AIMING MODE!
When the small monitor opened, you could switch to Manual mode by the Up Button on the Right Hand,
Otherwise, it will be in Auto aiming mode.
In the Manual Aiming Mode, there will be a line point out from your right-hand controller,
use it to aim your target.

4.NEW! Target Lock On Hints!
Finding out a target in Auto Aiming Mode, or, aiming target in Manual Aiming Mode, 
A Locked On hint will appear at the target, 
the HP will be shown if the target is an UNKNOWN SPACE LIFE.

5. Information description added to the Parts Panel 
Power and Weight information will be shown now，
other information will be added later, such as Function description.

6. Take out parts from Parts Panel 
The parts will be bigger and bigger until it becomes the original size

7. Information of the ship shows on the LEFT hand now.

8. Solve a bug which makes some parts working incorrectly.

Please keep your eyes on us, we will keep updating it very soon, 

with a Cute and Lovely AI assistant! 

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
